title: St. Paul Cathedral Daily Guided Tour
includes: Guided tour guests get exclusive "behind the velvet ropes" access to The Cathedral of St. Paul.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the iconic St. Paul’s Cathedral with a daily guided tour that uncovers its rich history and architectural splendor. This one-hour experience includes visits to the majestic sanctuary, where the grandeur of Beaux-Arts design captivates. Delve into the significance of the Shrines of Nations, which honor the diverse immigrant communities. Your knowledgeable guide provides engaging storytelling about the cathedral's sacred art and history, making every moment enlightening. Ideal for adults and history enthusiasts, this tour is wheelchair accessible, ensuring everyone can appreciate the beauty of this sacred space.

- One-hour guided tour of St. Paul’s Cathedral
- Learn about the architecture and sacred art
- Visit the Shrines of Nations honoring immigrant contributions
- Wheelchair accessible and suitable for adults over 10 years old
